get.description: Finds a project by its unique ID (e.g. `proj_1`) or project key (e.g. `CPE`).

get.description: Aggregates overall task distribution across statuses and project health metrics for dashboard widgets.

delete.description: Deletes a task by ID or key. Requires authentication.

patch.description: Dedicated endpoint to transition task status between 'backlog', 'in_progress', 'in_review', and 'done'.
